decisive_items: necrotizing granulomatous inflammation without evidence of malignancy
cytoplasmic ANCA titre of 1 / 20 and a PR3 level of 14.6 IU ml−1
response.rationale: Biopsy showing necrotizing granulomatous inflammation plus c-ANCA/PR3 positivity strongly supports Wegener's granulomatosis; cavitating lung cancer is excluded by the absence of malignancy on biopsy.

rejected.why: Biopsy explicitly showed no evidence of malignancy, contradicting cavitating lung cancer.
